# Streamlabs sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Add a donation to Streamlabs

Adds a donation to Streamlabs by hand, for example cash handed over at a meetup, so goals and lists count it. At most 2 a minute. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Donor name** | The donor's name, 2 to 25 characters. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **Amount** | The amount. Starts as: `5`. |
| **Currency** | The currency code, like USD. Starts as: `USD`. |
| **Message** | Optional message, under 255 characters. |
| **Skip the alert** | Tick to add it without playing an alert. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slDonationId%` | The new donation's id, when Streamlabs says it |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.createDonation`</small>

## Add Streamlabs points

Gives a viewer Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points, or takes them away with a negative number. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The viewer's login name. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Points** | How many points. Negative numbers remove points. Starts as: `100`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slPoints%` | Their points afterwards |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.addPoints`</small>

## Control Streamlabs alerts

Controls your Streamlabs alert box: skip the alert showing now, pause or resume the alert queue, mute or unmute alert sounds, or show or hide the media share video. Great for a Stream Deck button. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Action** | What to do. Options: Skip the current alert, Pause the queue, Resume the queue, Mute alert sounds, Unmute alert sounds, Show media share video, Hide media share video. Starts as: `Skip the current alert`. |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.alertQueue`</small>

## Control Streamlabs media share

Controls Streamlabs media share: play, pause, skip, volume, and turning requests, autoplay, auto-show or moderation on or off. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Action** | What to do. Options: Play, Pause, Skip, Play back, Volume up, Volume down, Allow requests, Stop requests, Autoplay on, Autoplay off, Auto-show on, Auto-show off, Moderation on, Moderation off. Starts as: `Skip`. |
| **Volume (0-100, volume actions only)** | For the volume actions only: a level from 0 to 100. Leave empty to change by Streamlabs' own step. |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.mediaShare`</small>

## Empty the Streamlabs tip jar

Empties your Streamlabs tip jar widget. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.emptyJar`</small>

## Get latest Streamlabs donations

Gets your latest Streamlabs donations, newest first. Handy for a "last donation" command or credits. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Donations** | How many (1 to 100). Starts as: `5`. |
| **Currency** | Only this currency, like USD. Leave empty for all. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slDonationCount%` | How many came back |
| `%slDonation0User%` | The newest donor's name (then slDonation1User and so on) |
| `%slDonation0Amount%` | Its amount as a number |
| `%slDonation0Currency%` | Its currency code |
| `%slDonation0FormattedAmount%` | Its amount written nicely, like $5.00 |
| `%slDonation0Message%` | Its message |
| `%slDonation0Id%` | Its Streamlabs donation id |
| `%slDonation0CreatedAt%` | When it was made |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.getDonations`</small>

## Get Streamlabs alert queue status

Checks whether your Streamlabs alert queue is paused. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slAlertsPaused%` | True when the alert queue is paused |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.getAlertQueueStatus`</small>

## Get Streamlabs points

Looks up a viewer's Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The viewer's login name. The default %userName% means the person who ran the action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slPointsUser%` | The viewer's name |
| `%slPoints%` | Their points |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.getPoints`</small>

## Get Streamlabs points leaderboard

Gets the viewers with the most Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Users** | How many viewers. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slPointsLeaderCount%` | How many came back |
| `%slPointsLeader0User%` | The top viewer (then slPointsLeader1User and so on) |
| `%slPointsLeader0Total%` | Their points |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.getPointsLeaderboard`</small>

## Get top Streamlabs donors

Adds up your last 100 Streamlabs donations per donor and lists the biggest givers. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Donors** | How many donors. Starts as: `5`. |
| **Currency** | Only donations in this currency are added up (amounts are not converted). Starts as: `USD`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slTopDonorCount%` | How many donors came back |
| `%slTopDonor0User%` | The top donor (then slTopDonor1User and so on) |
| `%slTopDonor0Total%` | Their total as a number |
| `%slTopDonor0FormattedTotal%` | Their total written nicely |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.getTopDonors`</small>

## Give everyone Streamlabs points

Gives everyone in your channel Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Points** | How many points each. Starts as: `50`. |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.addPointsToAll`</small>

## Reset everyone's Streamlabs points

Sets everyone's Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points back to 0. This cannot be undone. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.resetPoints`</small>

## Roll the Streamlabs credits

Rolls your Streamlabs end credits. Streamlabs only rolls them while you are live; otherwise the step fails with a message saying so. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.rollCredits`</small>

## Send Streamlabs test alert

Asks Streamlabs to play one of its own test alerts in your alert box. Unlike "Send test event" on the Donations page, this shows on stream. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert** | Which test alert. Options: Follow, Subscription, Donation, Host, Bits, Raid. Starts as: `Follow`. |
| **Platform** | Twitch or YouTube style. Options: Twitch, YouTube. Starts as: `Twitch`. |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.sendTestAlert`</small>

## Set Streamlabs points

Sets a viewer's Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points to an exact number. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The viewer's login name. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Points** | The new number of points. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slPoints%` | Their points afterwards |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.setPoints`</small>

## Show a custom Streamlabs alert

Shows your own alert in the Streamlabs alert box, styled like one of its alert types. Streamlabs asks apps to send at most 2 a minute, so Cuebot waits when you send more. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert type (its style is used)** | Which alert style to borrow: donation, follow, subscription or host. Options: Donation, Follow, Subscription, Host. Starts as: `Donation`. |
| **Message** | The main text. Put words in *stars* to highlight them, like *%user%* says hi. Starts as: `*%user%* says hi!`. |
| **Second line** | Optional second line under the main text. |
| **Image or GIF URL** | Optional link to an image or GIF. Empty uses the alert type's own. |
| **Sound URL** | Optional link to a sound. Empty uses the alert type's own. |
| **Duration (ms, 0 = default)** | How long it shows, in milliseconds (5000 = 5 seconds). 0 uses the default. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Highlight colour** | Optional colour of the highlighted words, like #32C3A6. |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.createAlert`</small>

## Spin the Streamlabs wheel

Spins your Streamlabs spin-the-wheel widget. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.spinWheel`</small>

## Switch Streamlabs alert profile

Switches your Streamlabs alert profile, for example to a calmer set while Just Chatting. Pair it with a scene change. Needs your own Streamlabs app connected (Donations → Streamlabs → Connect with Streamlabs).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Profile name** | The profile name as Streamlabs shows it (capitals do not matter). |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slAlertProfileId%` | The id of the profile switched to |
| `%slAlertProfileName%` | Its name |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.setAlertProfile`</small>
